This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.774 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +1.8 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 775 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams 0 goals. Team corrections so far: METALUL attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 1.8 goals), no bet.
